CAS — 8047-67-4. ATC — B03AB02; B03AC02. ATC Vet — QB03AB02; QB03AC02. Pharmacopoeias. In Swiss. US includes an injection. USP 31 (Iron Sucrose Injection). A sterile, colloidal solution of ferric hydroxide in complex with sucrose in water for injection. Sodium hydroxide may be added to adjust the pH. It contains no antimicrobial agent, chelating agent, dextran, gluconate, or other added substances. pH 10.5 to 11.1 at 20°. It is intended for intra- venous use only. When given by intravenous infusion, it should be diluted with 0.9% sodium chloride injection to a concentra- tion of 0.5 to 2.0 mg of elemental iron/mL. Do not allow to freeze.
